definitions.added here: Code supplied for this comparison, distinct from the listed original package functions.
definitions.PF + Adam, alpha=1: Differentiable particle-filter likelihood optimized with Adam; 425 updates from the original starting values, without IF2 initialization. Actual PF and optimizer calls are listed by package.
definitions.scope: Calling a package PF does not imply that the complete parameter-estimation procedure is supplied by that package.

Dynamax: SSM.fit_sgd is supplied by Dynamax; Dacca PF, IF2 and IFAD were added here. Adam uses optax.scale_by_adam.
PFJAX: The gradient phases call pfjax.particle_filter with our corrected_resampler; IF2 uses pfjax.resample_multinomial in our loop. Adam uses optax.scale_by_adam. These results are not the native OT method, whose differentiation failed.
